<thought>Search for retrosynthetic templates where a ketone and a C‑C triple bond are broken in the forward direction (i.e., they are present in the precursors). These correspond to the hint that the cycloaddition loses a ketone and an alkyne.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C triple bonds"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
